title: 中文快速上手：第一次看清 Agent 工具闭环

source.viewer_diff_since_capture: The capture ran from a documentation-only working tree at product baseline 644e6de; no uncommitted change existed under bin, src, integrations, package.json, or package-lock.json.

teaching_contract.audience: First-time PMA users who already have one working Agent or Harness.
teaching_contract.question: How do I install PMA, capture one safe session, and trace a user request through tool calls, results, final response, and native protocol evidence?
teaching_contract.takeaway: PMA does not replace the Agent. It organizes the Agent-to-model requests and tool exchanges into a traceable evidence chain.

viewer.capture_method: Automated local Chromium controlling the live PMA Viewer through scripts/capture-readme-source-frames.mjs
viewer.layout: full three-pane Viewer; no browser chrome, black frame, or baked annotation

scenario.user_request: 请先查看当前文件夹有哪些内容，再读取 README.md 中的「项目目标」部分，最后用一句话说明这个项目是做什么的。

facts: The current package requires Node.js 24 or newer.
The current CLI help lists npm install, pma doctor, pma open, pma codex, the Codex full-permission flag, pma shutdown, and pma clear --all-sessions with the documented meanings.
The quick-start Trace contains one Turn and three OpenAI Responses requests.
Request 2 contains the matching list_directory result and returns a read_file function_call.
Request 3 contains the matching README result and returns the final answer.
The Viewer preserves links from each tool result back to its originating call.
The Protocol view preserves instructions, tools, messages, calls, results, model id, and native order.
The Request Rail threshold is five requests in the active Turn; the navigation demo contains six Turns and thirteen Requests, with five Requests in Turn 5.

annotation_policy: Numbered markers appear in narration order and never enter as a complete set.
Independent focus changes crossfade over approximately 0.7 seconds and remove the previous marker.
Tabs that already name the target, including System, tool_result, Response and 协议视图, use a light focus outline without a redundant numbered circle.
The Turn Rail marker remains when the Request Rail marker appears because the scene teaches their hierarchy and recommended order; dim_ms lowers the retained Turn marker to a secondary visual level.
No routed arrow is used in v0.2; focus outlines, pane position, and progressive badges already establish every relationship.
Command scenes are explicit presentation cards, not simulated terminal screenshots.
product_feedback: During documentation verification, `pma open --help` opened or started the dashboard instead of printing subcommand help, while `pma clear --help` returned the explicit --all-sessions error. The guide therefore documents only tested commands and does not tell users to discover these subcommands with --help. This docs branch records the CLI discoverability gap but does not change runtime behavior.
